scope: Node.js offline synthetic-wire and mocked Egern API checks only. No Egern/iOS runtime, live Google response, Apple product availability, price or entitlement verification.
checks_passed: golden wire bytes: 16-byte SKU becomes 25 bytes
nested lengths grow across the 127-byte varint boundary
ancestor lengths grow across the 16383-byte varint boundary
full-value matching preserves an SKU embedded in longer text
unrelated title and price bytes are unchanged
uint64, fixed32, fixed64 and noncanonical varints remain byte identical
field path allowlist selects only the requested nested occurrence
invalid/truncated root messages are rejected without partial results
uncompressed gRPC lengths and unrelated frames are preserved correctly
gRPC-web trailer bytes are preserved
compressed, truncated and base64 gRPC are rejected
target scope excludes other domains, methods and purchase verification
request phase asks for identity encoding and retains auth headers
default inspect reports a candidate and returns identical bytes
rewrite returns valid bytes and clears stale length/digest metadata
gRPC MIME is accepted by the Egern entrypoint
malformed payload after a candidate passes through all original bytes
compression, errors, JSON and invalid options pass through before consuming
no-match response stays byte identical
field-count and nesting limits fail open in Egern
body-size limit returns original bytes
disabled notifications do not affect processing
no-match inspection reports a different product candidate without changing bytes
raw target inside composite text is distinguished from a complete field match
diagnostics distinguish path filtering from absence of the target
diagnostics from a malformed nested parse are discarded
candidate diagnostics are bounded and exclude arbitrary account or auth strings
empty protobuf inspection reports zero bytes and zero parsed fields
gRPC candidate diagnostics merge across frames without changing inspection bytes
duplicate early candidates cannot hide a later Ultra-like candidate
clipboard report includes all retained unique candidates beyond the preview
nested candidate deduplication preserves first path and counts every occurrence
